name: edge-tools
description: Internal EDGE team marketplace: Claude Code plugins for the design + development cycle.

plugins.name: ds-helper
plugins.description: Design-system-bound design & development, integrated with Figma: build a screen (design-builder), turn a design into bound code (figma-to-code), and verify code against the design (figma-fidelity). Ships a Dell profile; works for any design system via profiles.

plugins.name: agile-helper
plugins.description: Skills de apoio ao fluxo agile de desenvolvimento: criacao/manutencao de itens de QA no Jira (Epics, User Stories, Criterios de Aceite, Test Cases), quebra de User Stories em Subtasks, sugestao de composicao de sprint, e abertura de Pull Requests seguindo o padrao do time.
